evidence.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization

summary: Researchers have introduced a three‑phase post‑training pipeline—Inject, Align, Recover—that enables large language models to absorb and use document‑level information without relying on external retrieval mechanisms. Experiments show the approach matches or outperforms retrieval‑augmented systems while reducing latency and infrastructure complexity.
title: New Staged Post‑Training Method Lets Language Models Internalize Document Knowledge Without Retrieval
